items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a self-equivalence of the quotient of a minimal smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors on the category of Artinian algebras is an isomorphism (statement lines 7140-7146). The proof (proof lines 7148-7177) translates the equivalence into a pair of morphisms, uses the commuting square of tangent spaces and minimality to make the first one an isomorphism, and handles the second either through the exact sequence of infinitesimal automorphisms or through the fibre product description. H2: a diagram chase with two routes for the second half, written out in full.
